title: Is It Still There? Place-Registered Verification Makes VLMs Reliable Scene-Change Detectors
abstract: arXiv:2611.18734v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A robot that returns to a space must tell which objects were added, removed or moved since its last visit, while its trajectory, viewpoints and lighting differ between the two visits. We find that multi-image vision-language models (VLMs) fail at this task mainly because they cannot find the place where an object was. A VLM recognises what each frame shows but cannot check whether an object is still at its place in the other capture. It therefore reports objects that only one capture shows and misses most removed and moved objects. We propose STILL, which reformulates change detection as object verification at a registered place. 3D geometry registers the place of each change hypothesis in the other capture, and one VLM answers, from a scene view and a local place view, whether the object is still at that place, trained with supervision of the same form. translated_title: 它还在那里吗？基于位置配准的验证使视觉语言模型成为可靠的场景变化检测器
translated_abstract: 返回某个空间的机器人必须判断自上次访问以来哪些物体被添加、移除或移动了，而两次访问之间其轨迹、视角和光照都会有所不同。我们发现，多图像视觉语言模型（VLM）在这项任务上失败的主要原因在于它们无法找到物体原先所在的位置。VLM能够识别每一帧所显示的内容，却无法检查物体在另一次采集的对应位置上是否仍然存在。因此，它会报告仅在一次采集中出现的物体，并遗漏大多数被移除和被移动的物体。我们提出STILL，将变化检测重新表述为在配准位置上的物体验证问题。3D几何将每个变化假设的位置配准到另一次采集中，随后由一个VLM根据场景视图和局部位置视图回答物体是否仍处于该位置，并以相同形式的监督进行训练。在官方SceneDiff协议下，STILL将主要指标obj/sc AP从……
tldr: 该论文提出STILL方法，利用3D几何将每个变化假设的位置配准到另一次采集中，将场景变化检测转化为“物体是否仍在原位置”的验证任务，从而让视觉语言模型成为可靠的场景变化检测器。
en_tdlr: STILL reformulates scene-change detection as place-registered object verification, using 3D geometry to register each change hypothesis in the other capture so a VLM can verify whether the object is still at that place, making VLMs reliable scene-change detectors.
